metadata.name: Order Rescue — 30-case MVP database model and raw seed
metadata.status: Aligned synthetic seed and implementation contract. Expected fixture labels are user-reviewed; actual Agent accuracy has not been measured.
metadata.scope: Nine tables, 67 columns; two possible assessment slots; final policy can override policy 1 on no-reply. Raw sources only are seeded.
metadata.revision_note: Reconciled workbook plus approved v2.5 business rules: one focused question; direct Ops without contact; no-reply final review; complete logistics missing_info.

assessment_rules.payment_hypothesis: PAYMENT_ISSUE requires a payment-specific observation or statement. Payment type COD alone, including a vague note merely repeating COD, is not cause evidence; use UNKNOWN_CAUSE when no main cause is supported.
assessment_rules.cod_readiness: For a COD order, include COD_READINESS while current readiness is not established by available sources, even when the main hypothesis is not PAYMENT_ISSUE. Remove it only after supporting information is available.
assessment_rules.missing_info_scope: All unresolved information relevant to rescuing this order, including buyer intent/availability when routed to Ops; not just information needed for the next action.
assessment_rules.logistics: Specific logistics barriers requiring Ops are ESCALATE_REVIEW and NOT_ASKED. Vague traffic/peak notes alone remain UNKNOWN_CAUSE/LOW.
assessment_rules.retired_hold: HOLD_DISRUPTION is legacy catalogue data only. It is excluded from new assessment/policy output enums and workbook active dropdowns.

question_contract.primary_gap_selection: One most important buyer-answerable unresolved gap that can change the recommendation; do not ask a compound or multi-part question.

key_selection.CLARIFY_LANDMARK: Address/landmark/block/access or an address-related barrier at the registered receiving point.
key_selection.CONFIRM_INTENT: Other buyer-side clarification: intent, availability, contact, COD or cause. Classify by the primary purpose in case context.

dim_buyer.role: Buyer reference; buyer history is derived, not stored here

dim_product.role: Optional dimension, kept to match approved ERD; unavailable in synthetic source

dim_carrier.role: Optional dimension, kept to match approved ERD; unavailable in synthetic source

dim_date.role: Reference calendar derived from observed event timestamps

dim_action.role: Action catalogue including retired legacy HOLD_DISRUPTION; use shared_contract.candidate_action for active new output codes.

fact_order.role: Current and past orders; history is obtained by buyer_id and delivery-event join

fact_delivery_event.role: Carrier/delivery raw observations, including historical attempts and results

order_rescue.role: One rescue case; initial and optional after-reply assessment/policy snapshots; immutable final assessment selection with outcome-dependent final policy.

columns.as_of: ISO datetime; current allowed read cutoff
columns.deadline_at: ISO datetime|null; logistics deadline, not reply-wait duration
columns.final_assessment: object|null; exact copy of selected assessment, not a third assessment
columns.eligibility: ELIGIBLE|INELIGIBLE|UNKNOWN|null; final policy result; may override policy 1 after no-reply
columns.policy_gate: PERMITTED|BLOCKED|ESCALATED|null; final policy result; may override policy 1 after no-reply
columns.final_action_id: string|null; final policy action, including no-reply review override; FK to dim_action.action_id

final_assessment_source.rule: 1 = initial assessment for USER_NO_REPLY or NOT_ASKED; 2 = after reply; null before final or pre-AI bypass. This selector does not force final policy to copy the same stage.

cross_field_constraints: Validate populated Agent output and policy, then persist initial slots before emitting or displaying a buyer question.
At most one AI_QUESTION per case and one primary information gap in its text; no follow-up after reply/no-reply.
after_reply slots exist only after one valid matching BUYER_REPLY. USER_NO_REPLY and NOT_ASKED leave both slots null.
BUYER_REPLY: final_assessment_source=2 and final assessment/policy copy after-reply outputs.
USER_NO_REPLY after initial CLARIFY: final_assessment_source=1 and final assessment equals initial exactly; final policy is ESCALATED/ESCALATE_REVIEW while initial_policy_output remains unchanged.
NOT_ASKED: no question, no runtime response and question_wait_state=null; finalize from ASSESSED with source=1 and initial assessment/policy.
Source=1 identifies the assessment only; final policy is not required to equal initial policy for USER_NO_REPLY.
Persist final fields atomically once. A completed case is immutable; no third assessment or second question.
A preserved final candidate CLARIFY after no-reply is historical assessment output; final policy routes to Ops and cannot emit another question.
Pre-AI bypass is outside the 30 fixtures and keeps Agent assessment slots null.

fact_rescue_interaction.role: Source messages/context and runtime controls; no contact/call tracking. T0 buyer context is distinct from post-question buyer reply.

columns.interaction_id: string, required; source reference and idempotency key
columns.question_id: string|null; runtime response/control must bind to the pending question
columns.message_text: string|null; USER_NO_REPLY has no buyer message
columns.occurred_at: ISO datetime, required; runtime assigned when an event is released

conditional_constraints: At most one row with interaction_type=AI_QUESTION for each case_id.
At most one response outcome (BUYER_REPLY or USER_NO_REPLY) for the pending question in this two-stage demo.
BUYER_CONTEXT is phase T0 and has question_id=null; do not count it as the reply that triggers assessment 2.
BUYER_REPLY and USER_NO_REPLY bind question_id to the actual existing AI_QUESTION; ignore duplicate event IDs.
USER_NO_REPLY message_text=null and payload.buyer_reply=null; actor is demo_operator, not buyer.
NOT_ASKED is a contact outcome, not an interaction type. It emits no question, reply or no-reply control.

constraints: One rescue case per unique failed_event_id; existing NEW seed cases are processed without creating duplicates.
Failed event and rescue case must refer to the same order.
Seed only raw sources known at T0. Never seed expected assessments, future question/reply text, chosen response mode or golden labels.
Nine tables and 67 columns. Two possible assessment slots; final is a selected assessment, not a third Agent round.
Buyer history is derived from prior orders and delivery events with cutoff filtering; [] is valid for this suite.
New assessment/policy output enums exclude retired HOLD_DISRUPTION although its legacy catalogue row remains.
Every source_ref resolves to a source available for that case and stage with correct provenance.
Final policy follows the outcome-specific finalization rule; no-reply review does not overwrite policy 1.
No real messaging, dispatch, return, refund, address/COD modification or fabricated contact logs.

query_recipes.open_case: Read order_rescue by case_id; join fact_order by order_id and fact_delivery_event by failed_event_id; check both refer to the same order.
query_recipes.buyer_history: Read other orders of the same buyer_id, join delivery events and filter event_time <= as_of; [] is valid and matches this suite.
query_recipes.initial_agent_input: Assemble the seven core fields from database rows, excluding all assessment/policy/result fields. Reconstruct operational_context.buyer_messages_t0 from BUYER_CONTEXT T0 interactions when present.
query_recipes.runtime_context: Supply only released RUNTIME interactions for this case in a separate runtime_context envelope; do not overwrite failed_event or put current reply into buyer_history.
query_recipes.source_references: source_ref_index indexes T0 sources. Runtime interaction_id is its own source_ref; register only when the event is actually released.
query_recipes.write_initial: Use write_initial after validation/policy. Persist first, then either open one permitted question or finalize NOT_ASKED.
query_recipes.write_after_reply: After a valid matching reply, advance the read cutoff, rebuild raw input plus runtime context, run Agent once, validate and compute policy 2; persist after-reply and final together with finalize_after_contact.
query_recipes.write_no_reply: Store a demo_operator USER_NO_REPLY control. Leave after-reply slots null; select initial assessment exactly but compute final ESCALATED/ESCALATE_REVIEW, preserving initial policy.
query_recipes.final_write: Use outcome-specific finalization: assessment selector 1/2; no-reply final policy overrides policy 1, otherwise copy policy from selected stage. Finalize atomically once.
query_recipes.evaluate: Only isolated test runner reads the paired test file expected data. Agent/tools have database input views only.
query_recipes.write_not_asked: No interactions/question state are created. Use finalize_not_asked from ASSESSED with initial assessment and policy.
query_recipes.question: Choose one primary buyer-answerable missing_info gap; generate one focused question under one of two broad keys, never a compound request.

source_ref.description: Reference to a source known at this assessment stage.

fact.description: Sourced observation; distinguish reported claims from confirmed facts.

confidence.description: Strength of support for the hypothesis, not delivery-success probability.

missing_info.description: [] means nothing remains missing; a null assessment means no assessment exists.

question_key.description: Planned category at stage 1; category of the question already asked at stage 2/final. Does not authorize a second question.

oneOf.description: No reply deadline or fixed duration. NO_REPLY is a manual demo control, not a buyer statement.

sql_recipes.load_case:
SELECT
    c.case_id, c.order_id, c.failed_event_id, c.as_of,
    c.current_status AS case_status,
    c.attempts_used, c.return_state, c.deadline_at, c.policy_version,
    o.buyer_id, o.payment_type, o.current_status AS order_status,
    o.operational_context,
    e.order_id AS event_order_id,
    e.event_time, e.event_type, e.event_status,
    e.courier_note, e.reported_reason, e.source_actor
FROM order_rescue AS c
JOIN fact_order AS o ON o.order_id = c.order_id
JOIN fact_delivery_event AS e ON e.event_id = c.failed_event_id
WHERE c.case_id = :case_id;
sql_recipes.buyer_history:
SELECT
    prior.order_id, h.event_id, h.event_time,
    h.event_type, h.event_status, h.courier_note, h.source_actor
FROM order_rescue AS c
JOIN fact_order AS current_order ON current_order.order_id = c.order_id
JOIN fact_order AS prior ON prior.buyer_id = current_order.buyer_id
JOIN fact_delivery_event AS h ON h.order_id = prior.order_id
WHERE c.case_id = :case_id
  AND prior.order_id <> current_order.order_id
  AND h.event_time <= :as_of
ORDER BY h.event_time, h.event_id;
sql_recipes.t0_context:
SELECT interaction_id, interaction_type, message_text, occurred_at, source_actor
FROM fact_rescue_interaction
WHERE case_id = :case_id
  AND available_phase = 'T0'
  AND interaction_type = 'BUYER_CONTEXT'
  AND occurred_at <= :as_of
ORDER BY occurred_at, interaction_id;
sql_recipes.runtime_context:
SELECT
    interaction_id, interaction_type, available_phase,
    question_id, question_key, message_text,
    occurred_at, source_actor, payload
FROM fact_rescue_interaction
WHERE case_id = :case_id
  AND available_phase = 'RUNTIME'
  AND occurred_at <= :as_of
ORDER BY occurred_at, interaction_id;
sql_recipes.write_initial:
UPDATE order_rescue
SET initial_assessment = :initial_assessment,
    initial_policy_output = :initial_policy_output,
    current_status = 'ASSESSED',
    as_of = :as_of,
    updated_at = :updated_at
WHERE case_id = :case_id
  AND current_status = 'NEW'
  AND initial_assessment IS NULL
  AND initial_policy_output IS NULL
  AND final_assessment IS NULL;
sql_recipes.open_question:
UPDATE order_rescue
SET question_wait_state = :question_wait_state,
    current_status = 'WAITING_FOR_BUYER',
    as_of = :as_of,
    updated_at = :updated_at
WHERE case_id = :case_id
  AND current_status = 'ASSESSED'
  AND initial_assessment IS NOT NULL
  AND initial_policy_output IS NOT NULL
  AND question_wait_state IS NULL
  AND after_reply_assessment IS NULL
  AND final_assessment IS NULL;
sql_recipes.finalize_not_asked:
UPDATE order_rescue
SET final_assessment_source = 1,
    final_assessment = initial_assessment,
    eligibility = :eligibility,
    policy_gate = :policy_gate,
    final_action_id = :final_action_id,
    reason = :reason,
    current_status = 'COMPLETED',
    as_of = :as_of,
    updated_at = :updated_at
WHERE case_id = :case_id
  AND current_status = 'ASSESSED'
  AND initial_assessment IS NOT NULL
  AND initial_policy_output IS NOT NULL
  AND question_wait_state IS NULL
  AND after_reply_assessment IS NULL
  AND after_reply_policy_output IS NULL
  AND final_assessment_source IS NULL
  AND final_assessment IS NULL;
sql_recipes.finalize_after_contact:
UPDATE order_rescue
SET after_reply_assessment = :after_reply_assessment,
    after_reply_policy_output = :after_reply_policy_output,
    final_assessment_source = :final_assessment_source,
    final_assessment = :final_assessment,
    eligibility = :eligibility,
    policy_gate = :policy_gate,
    final_action_id = :final_action_id,
    reason = :reason,
    question_wait_state = :question_wait_state,
    current_status = 'COMPLETED',
    as_of = :as_of,
    updated_at = :updated_at
WHERE case_id = :case_id
  AND current_status = 'WAITING_FOR_BUYER'
  AND initial_assessment IS NOT NULL
  AND initial_policy_output IS NOT NULL
  AND after_reply_assessment IS NULL
  AND after_reply_policy_output IS NULL
  AND final_assessment_source IS NULL
  AND final_assessment IS NULL;
sql_recipes.show_assessments:
SELECT
    case_id, current_status,
    initial_assessment, initial_policy_output,
    after_reply_assessment, after_reply_policy_output,
    final_assessment_source, final_assessment,
    eligibility, policy_gate, final_action_id, reason,
    question_wait_state
FROM order_rescue
WHERE case_id = :case_id;

demo_policy_profile.clarify_when_final: After no-reply, final assessment may retain candidate CLARIFY because it is an unchanged initial copy; final policy is review. Never send another question.

agent_input_envelope.runtime_context: Only released runtime interactions; empty at stage 1

write: question_wait_state stays null; no runtime interactions
final policy ESCALATED/ESCALATE_REVIEW; initial policy unchanged

runtime_contract.time: Use fixed fixture clock, not host wall clock. JSON ISO timestamps may contain offsets; normalize UTC in DB and compare instants. Advance cutoff before processing released interactions.
runtime_contract.database_isolation: Reset/clone this seed per test run. Agent reads an explicit raw-input projection, never complete order_rescue rows containing prior outputs.
runtime_contract.atomicity: Question storage and transition are atomic/idempotent; response outcomes serialized per case; after-reply and final written together; final immutable.

runtime_contract.validation: Every actual Agent execution requires non-null agent_assessment_output. Validate before policy/persist and before contact. No extra assessment round or follow-up question.

seed_notes: All 30 seed cases are NEW with every assessment/policy/final/question-state slot null.
Three T0 BUYER_CONTEXT interactions are raw synthetic input known before the question. They are projected into operational_context.buyer_messages_t0.
There are no seeded AI_QUESTION, BUYER_REPLY, USER_NO_REPLY or NOT_ASKED records. Future response text and modes are only in the isolated test file.
No history is invented; buyer_history=[] for the suite. Optional product/carrier/buyer attributes remain unavailable/null.
source_ref_index covers T0 sources only. Released runtime interaction_id becomes a source_ref at runtime.
HOLD_DISRUPTION catalogue row is retired compatibility data, excluded from new output enums. No decision-log table is added.
